name: Everyday helper
author: RdotA
description: Plan your day, decide faster and turn notes into actions.

prompts.title: Plan my day
prompts.text: Help me plan today ({day}). Here's what I need to do: {ask:Your to-do list}. Order it sensibly, estimate times, and add short breaks.

prompts.title: Summarise this
prompts.text:
Summarise this in five bullet points and one sentence on why it matters:

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Help me decide
prompts.text: Help me decide between {ask:Options}. Ask me up to three questions first if you need to, then give a recommendation with the trade-offs.

prompts.title: Draft a reply
prompts.text:
Draft a polite, clear reply to this message. Keep it short:

{clipboard}

prompts.title: Meeting notes to actions
prompts.text:
Turn these meeting notes into a list of decisions and action items, each with an owner and a due date if mentioned:

{clipboard}
